subject: MFA reset required
top_finding: QR code in a short message

message.subject: MFA reset required
message.excerpt: Your multi-factor authentication token has expired. Scan the QR code in this message to re-enroll within 24 hours.

findings.title: QR code in a short message
evidence: Short message pushes a QR code, which hides the destination link
The QR code comes with account or deadline wording
findings.lesson: A QR code hides the link from filters and from you. Only scan codes you expected, and check where they go.

findings.title: Asks you to sign in, and fast
evidence: Wording asks for credentials under pressure: "mfa"; "within 24 hours"
findings.lesson: Pressure plus a login request is the classic pairing. Pause, then go to the site on your own.
